fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Uncheck to hide this courier from the dashboard filter and skip it in scheduled tracking. Master list entries are seeded disabled - enable the ones you actually use.

fields.label: Tracking Source
fields.options:
Aggregator
Direct Courier API
Custom HTTP

fields.label: Tracking Integration
fields.description: Use an aggregator such as Shiprocket, or a direct courier integration.

fields.label: Adapter Python Path
fields.description: Leave blank when using the configured integration.

fields.label: Tracking Parameter
fields.description: Used when the URL does not contain {tracking_id}.

fields.label: Auth Header Style
fields.description: How the API Key/Token above should be sent. Most REST APIs want Bearer Token; some want a custom header (e.g. a courier-specific key name).

fields.label: Custom Header Name
fields.description: Header name to use when Auth Header Style is Custom Header or Both.

fields.label: Tracking URL Template
fields.description: Use {tracking_id} where the AWB should be inserted.

fields.label: Ageing Threshold (Hours)
fields.description: Flag a shipment on this courier as No Movement / Follow-up after this many hours without a status change.

fields.label: Escalation Email(s)
fields.description: Comma-separated. Notified when a shipment on this courier newly needs follow-up or goes No Movement.
